Under the direct supervision of the clinic manager and the general supervision of the clinic providers, the Medical Assistant (MA) performs work that requires specific knowledge and training in patient care duties within the Business and Professions Code of the State of California and the regulations of the Joint Commission of the Accreditation of Hospitals (TJC).

These duties also include, but are not limited to: scheduling patient appointments and managing associated system screens, ensuring accurate billing, performing environmental care functions, equipment and supply management, and maintaining cleanliness through proper cleaning and disinfecting protocols. This role requires knowledge of medical terminology, online scheduling, universal precautions, and proper use of body mechanics. The Medical Assistant also must demonstrate initiative, effectively prioritize multiple demands, and work collaboratively in a team environment. Additional related duties may be assigned as needed.
Knowledge in medical terminology, online scheduling, universal precautions, and proper use of body mechanics.
Proficient with venipuncture and must be signed off for competency within 6 months of hiring.
Requires initiative and the ability to prioritize multiple demands.
Knowledge and understanding of FLOW process specific to UCSD community care.
Demonstrates strong interpersonal skills and collaborates effectively in a team-oriented environment.
Demonstrated understanding of quality metrics, including pre-charting and pre-visit planning workflows to support efficient, patient-centered care.
Demonstrated ability to manage clinician workflows to ensure streamlined operations and high-quality patient care.
